shellCommands.command: git status --short && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50
cat next.config.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx lib/projects.ts tsconfig.json; echo ---; git diff package.json; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/

echo "== prerendered shell ==" && grep -o '<main>.*</main>' .next/server/app/index.html | sed 's/<!--[^>]*-->//g' | head -c 600; echo; echo "== live request =="; (npx next start -p 3123 >/tmp/start.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; curl -s -H 'Cookie: member=Ada; team=Platform' -H 'x-region: eu-west' http://localhost:3123/ | grep -o '<main>.*</main>' | sed 's/<!--[^>]*-->//g' | head -c 600; echo; curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -oE 'Welcome, [A-Za-z]+|Team: [A-Za-z]+|Region: [a-z-]+'; pkill -f 'next start' || true

(npx next start -p 3124 >/tmp/start.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; echo "== with cookies/header =="; curl -s -H 'Cookie: member=Ada; team=Platform' -H 'x-region: eu-west' http://localhost:3124/ | grep -oE 'Welcome, [A-Za-z]+|Team: [A-Za-z]+|Region: [a-z-]+|[0-9]+ active projects'; echo "== anonymous =="; curl -s http://localhost:3124/ | grep -oE 'Welcome, [A-Za-z]+|Team: [A-Za-z]+|Region: [a-z-]+|[0-9]+ active projects'; kill $(pgrep -f 'next start') 2>/dev/null; true
cat /tmp/start.log; pgrep -af next || echo "no next processes"

echo "== with cookies/header =="; curl -s -H 'Cookie: member=Ada; team=Platform' -H 'x-region: eu-west' http://localhost:3124/ | grep -oE 'Welcome, [A-Za-z]+|Team: [A-Za-z]+|Region: [a-z-]+|[0-9]+ active projects'; echo "== anonymous =="; curl -s http://localhost:3124/ | grep -oE 'Welcome, [A-Za-z]+|Team: [A-Za-z]+|Region: [a-z-]+|[0-9]+ active projects'
curl -s -D - -H 'Cookie: member=Ada; team=Platform' -H 'x-region: eu-west' http://localhost:3124/ | head -c 3000; echo; echo ==; cat /tmp/start.log | tail -5

echo "== with cookies/header =="; curl -s -H 'Cookie: member=Ada; team=Platform' -H 'x-region: eu-west' http://localhost:3124/ | sed 's/<!--[^>]*-->//g' | grep -oE 'Welcome, [A-Za-z]+|Team: [A-Za-z]+|Region: [a-z-]+|[0-9]+ active projects'; echo "== anonymous =="; curl -s http://localhost:3124/ | sed 's/<!--[^>]*-->//g' | grep -oE 'Welcome, [A-Za-z]+|Team: [A-Za-z]+|Region: [a-z-]+|[0-9]+ active projects'; kill 439 426 2>/dev/null; true
